Name: Canonical model
Description: The platform shall maintain one governed canonical enterprise data model shared by all modules.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Tenant key
Description: Every tenant-owned record shall include a verified tenant identifier.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Global identifiers
Description: Every governed entity shall use immutable globally unique identifiers.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Versioning
Description: Versioned entities shall preserve historical versions and effective dates.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Soft deletion
Description: Business records shall use governed lifecycle states rather than uncontrolled physical deletion.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Audit columns
Description: Every mutable record shall capture creation and last-change actor and timestamp.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Optimistic concurrency
Description: Mutable records shall support version checks to prevent lost updates.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Reference data
Description: Codes and enumerations shall be represented through governed reference sets.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Custom fields
Description: Tenant custom fields shall use typed governed definitions and values.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Data ownership
Description: Each entity and field shall have an accountable data owner.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: System of record
Description: Each governed field shall declare its authoritative source.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Null semantics
Description: Required, optional, unknown, not applicable, and withheld values shall be distinguishable where material.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Precision
Description: Numeric values shall store declared precision, scale, and unit or currency context.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Time handling
Description: Timestamps shall use UTC with source timezone where business meaning requires it.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Effective dating
Description: Rates, assignments, relationships, and classifications shall support effective-date ranges.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Natural keys
Description: External or business keys shall not replace immutable internal identifiers.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Cross-entity references
Description: References shall enforce compatible tenant and lifecycle constraints.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Record classification
Description: Every entity shall inherit or define data security classification.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Retention
Description: Records shall map to retention and legal-hold policies.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Data lineage
Description: Imported, calculated, converted, and AI-generated values shall preserve lineage.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Source identity
Description: Imported records shall preserve source system and external identifier.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Duplicate prevention
Description: Party, vendor, customer, project, and resource master data shall support duplicate detection.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Merge controls
Description: Master-record merges shall preserve aliases, lineage, audit, and reversal evidence.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Relationship model
Description: Parties and business objects shall support typed effective-dated relationships.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Organization hierarchy
Description: Legal entities, business units, branches, teams, and projects shall support hierarchical relationships.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Project hierarchy
Description: Projects shall support programs, parent projects, phases, areas, and work packages.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Work breakdown
Description: Work records shall support WBS and cost-code structures without hardcoding one industry.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Estimate immutability
Description: Released estimate versions shall be immutable.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Estimate traceability
Description: Estimate lines shall retain quantity, production, resource, rate, markup, and source provenance.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Resource polymorphism
Description: Resource assignments and rates shall support labor, crew, equipment, material, and service resource types.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Rate effective dates
Description: Rates shall include location, source, currency, unit, and effective periods.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Financial separation
Description: Budget, commitment, actual, forecast, invoice, and payment records shall remain distinct.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Cost transaction integrity
Description: Cost transactions shall balance required dimensions and preserve source documents.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Currency integrity
Description: Money values shall always include currency.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Unit integrity
Description: Quantities shall always include unit and dimension.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Tax jurisdiction
Description: Tax calculations shall reference explicit jurisdiction and rule versions.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Document logical identity
Description: Documents shall have a stable logical identity independent of content versions.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Document version immutability
Description: Accepted document versions shall be immutable and checksummed.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Attachment model
Description: Documents shall link to any supported business object without duplicating content.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Signature evidence
Description: Electronic signatures shall preserve signer, method, timestamp, hash, and document version.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Spatial reference
Description: Geometry shall declare its coordinate reference system.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Spatial abstraction
Description: Business entities shall reference geometry without forcing all geometry into transactional tables.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Stationing
Description: Linear projects shall support station ranges and offsets.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Jurisdiction mapping
Description: Projects, sites, taxes, permits, and compliance records shall reference jurisdiction.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Safety linkage
Description: Incidents, inspections, observations, and corrective actions shall link to project, location, people, and evidence.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Qualification history
Description: Qualifications shall preserve issuer, type, dates, status, and evidence.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: AI provenance
Description: AI-created or modified values shall identify agent, model, prompt, evidence, and execution.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: AI writeback separation
Description: AI recommendations shall remain separate from committed business records until authorized writeback.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Feedback linkage
Description: Feedback shall link to the exact system or AI output version being evaluated.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Event envelope
Description: Domain events shall use a standard tenant-aware versioned envelope.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Change data capture
Description: Material record changes shall emit change metadata or domain events.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: API contract alignment
Description: API schemas shall map directly to canonical entities or declared view models.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Reporting model
Description: Operational entities shall support governed reporting views without duplicating source truth.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Search model
Description: Search documents shall remain derivative and traceable to canonical records.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Import staging
Description: Imports shall validate in staging before committed writes.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Export completeness
Description: Exports shall include identifiers, versions, units, currencies, and lineage needed for interpretation.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Schema evolution
Description: Breaking schema changes shall require versioned migration and compatibility plans.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Backward compatibility
Description: Published event and API contracts shall follow declared compatibility windows.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Data quality rules
Description: Critical fields shall have completeness, validity, uniqueness, consistency, and timeliness measures.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Data quality exceptions
Description: Failed quality rules shall create reviewable exceptions rather than silent correction.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Masking
Description: Sensitive fields shall support masking and tokenization policies.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Encryption attributes
Description: Highly sensitive data shall support field-level encryption metadata where required.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Regional residency
Description: Entity storage classes shall support region and residency constraints.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Archival tiers
Description: Archived records shall retain resolvable identifiers and access controls.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Legal hold
Description: Legal hold shall suspend deletion and archival expiration.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Referential integrity
Description: Deletion or archival shall not orphan governed references.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Materialized views
Description: Materialized reporting views shall identify refresh time and source versions.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Calculated fields
Description: Calculated values shall preserve formula or rule version and input lineage.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Confidence metadata
Description: Estimated or inferred values shall support confidence and review status.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Metadata extensibility

Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Localization
Description: Names, addresses, dates, numbers, units, and currencies shall support locale-aware presentation.
Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Data portability

Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Name: Seed data

Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.

Acceptance_Criteria: The requirement is represented in the entity model, rules, validation, migration, and test artifacts.
